description: Rule on the exact delivery attempt you inspected as the bounty's authority. Requires claim_id, delivery_attempt, decision and authority_ref. Read delivery_attempt from the current claim or review packet. A changed attempt refuses the verdict; inspect the new delivery before deciding. Acceptance consumes a funded slot and rejection sends work back for revision. Authority is sent as the bearer. Acceptance requires human quality evidence; rejection requires a public reason. POST /v1/judgments.

authority_token.description: Private authority token, sent as the bearer, when configured.

delivery_attempt.description: Exact delivery attempt from the packet being judged.

evidence.description: Human-readable evidence summary. Required by the API for accepted human judgments.

rubric_digest.description: Rubric digest used for the review.

rubric_results.description: Rubric results. At least one is required by the API for accepted human judgments.

reason.description: Public reason, required for rejection by the API.

name: frantic.judge_delivery
title: Judge Frantic delivery
